description: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY dispatching option 1 for a regular user: the first entry of app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy, 'Account View' targeting COACTVWC with authorisation column 'U'. The three-term guard at app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl:127-129 passes, the ungated filter at 136-137 evaluates and is false because the entry is 'U' and not 'A', and lines 147, 148 and 151 then set CDEMO-FROM-TRANID to 'CM00', CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM to 'COMEN01C' and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT back to zero before the XCTL at 152-155 transfers WITH the communication area. Lines 149 and 150 are commented out in the source, so CDEMO-USER-ID and CDEMO-USER-TYPE cross unchanged. An XCTL never returns, so no map is sent, no message is emitted and the coming-soon text at 159-163 is unreachable here.
